question: Which district has the denser paved road network, Lindenmoor or Redfen, and by how many km of road per square kilometre?

samples.text:
Facts used:
- Lindenmoor has 402.3 km of paved road and covers 1,015.7 km². [NR-08]
- Redfen has 244.6 km of paved road and covers 677.1 km². [NR-09]

Calculation:
- Lindenmoor road density = 402.3 ÷ 1,015.7 = 0.396 km/km².
- Redfen road density = 244.6 ÷ 677.1 = 0.361 km/km².
- Difference = 0.396 − 0.361 = 0.035 km/km².

Lindenmoor has the denser paved road network by 0.035 km of road per square kilometre.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 0.035
